focusedReproduction.type: Controlled DOM probe; synthetic client authentication; fresh isolated loopback PostgreSQL
focusedReproduction.limitations: Shared DOM causes for 13 of 19 CI failures were reproduced, not complete original-case or full-suite baseline execution. Six registration/SDK/My Bids cases retain exact artifact errors without exact baseline reruns. The contact suite was verified separately; it does not close the entire redesign gate.
focusedReproduction.setupCorrections: The baseline Next security stop required a legitimate identical retry. One local seed omitted required image alt and failed before browser use; corrected before successful observations. No baseline dependency or app-source upgrade.

gate: OPEN: require scoped contract/fixture triage and a complete successful required redesign run. Do not skip this gate or claim whole CI green.
